Kael Lancaster grew up believing his family was ordinary—until he discovered that his estranged grandfather, Theodore, was a multi billionaire.
Struggling with his family's debts and uncertain future, Kael decides to approach his grandfather and move into the Lancaster estate, becoming the old man's caretaker. For two years, he endures the family's contempt and Theodore's cold indifference, clinging to the hope that his loyalty will one day be rewarded.
But when Theodore dies, the will delivers a brutal blow: Kael inherits nothing.
Or so it seems.
However, His grandfather had left him something else.
A portal through which he could travel to another world—Kael can trade between worlds, amassing power beyond imagination.

the trainees of his gym were being threatened, harassed and made to leave. His gym went under and the loan repayments pilled up over the months.

the-legendary-programming-mage:
Read My Two Reviews!
Magic? Extra? Waifus? Tech?
Academy? Dungeons? Genius?
Slice Of Life? SSS-Rank Awakened?
Before I died, the world called me the Legendary Programmer.
I was Allen Park, born in the slums, hacker extraordinaire, and the most notorious member of the Night_Hawk organization.
Then came the betrayal.
My crew, who were like family to me, were slaughtered.
The government hunted us down and I was the last one left standing.
So I left them a parting gift, one final hack that plunged the world into chaos.
Then, I died.
…Or so I thought.
When I opened my eyes, I wasn’t Allen Park anymore.
I was Allen Vanderbilt—a useless extra in a novel my boss once forced me to read.
A world without technology.
A world where everything ran on magic.
But the truth was:
Magic wasn’t some mystical art... it was code.
And if it was code… that meant I could hack it. Debug it and rewrite it.
From spells to artifacts, from enchanted phones to magical cars, nothing in this world is safe from my touch.
I was the Legendary Programmer once.
Now, I’ll become the Legendary Programming Mage.
Because I, Allen Park, couldn't settle for less.

the-rebirth-of-han-yuxi:
At home, she was invisible; after marriage, she was a decorative vase; in the end, a sea of flames buried her, and not even her corpse remained. This is the portrait of Han Yuxi’s previous lifetime.
Given a chance at rebirth, she strives to improve herself, wishing only to no longer serve as a foil or a pretty face. Then, she will seek out an exemplary husband and live a life of peace and prosperity. Alas, things turn out contrary to her wishes—she marries a man who bears a blood feud and hatred as deep as the sea.
She turns the world upside-down, but her road to happiness is strewn with setbacks and the sweetness that comes after bitterness.
the-strange-adventure-of-a-broke-mercena: After the soldiers’ mercenary group where he used to work had been utterly destroyed, Loren, who survived the disaster, decided to walk the adventurer’s path as a way to make a living. However, for Loren who had no acquaintances and nothing but an empty pocket on him, receiving a single quest seemed like a faraway aim. So, as he was contemplating about what he should do next, another adventurer called out to him.

With no hope of finding love again in her life, Rachael agreed to marry her father's best friend's son, Andrew Collins. But little did she know fate had different plans for her.
…..
Excerpt:
Holding his drunk wife in his arms, Andrew kicked the bedroom door open.
When he placed her in the bed, Rachael slowly opened her eyes. “Are we home?”
“Yes.” Taking her heels off, he covered her with the quilt. “I'll get you some warm water.” But before he could get up, she grabbed his hand.
“What happened? Do you want something else?”
Kicking the quilt off, she crawled in his lap. Placing one hand on his cheek and the other at the back of his neck, she inched closer. “Andrew—”
“Hmm?”
“I think I am falling for you, what should I do?”
